outgoing.name: Alexander the Great
outgoing.excerpt: This inspired a sense of mystery and awe for the Greeks, and emphasized Alexander the Great's vast empire.

outgoing.name: Christianity
outgoing.excerpt: Over the next two centuries, the majority of Ephesians converted to Christianity, and the Temple of Artemis lost its religious appeal.

outgoing.name: Moon
outgoing.excerpt: Artemis was the Greek goddess, the virginal huntress and twin of Apollo, who supplanted the Titan Selene as Goddess of the Moon.
